description: Pre-registered frozen M1 OI/Crowding gated-Martin policy, 5-symbol equal-risk combination. Locked BEFORE the final cold-start evaluation per plan §6 (no selection after seeing results).
n_trials_claim_rationale: This is a single pre-registered policy. The config above was frozen before the cold-start evaluation.
